phone.name: Android Phone
phone.noteAr: تحديث المشغّل وإعدادات الشبكة وWireGuard المدمج، مع الريموت وحزم التلفزيون الحالية.
phone.noteEn: Shared player and network settings, embedded WireGuard engine, integrated remote and current TV packages.

changes: Unified visible version 1.1.303 for Launcher, IPTV, phone, desktop, remote and Legacy, with monotonic Android versionCode308.
Fire TV/Android: one bounded prayer-and-matches card; gold entitlement marker never overlaps Settings text.
All current application download, update, relay, theme and support origins use https://morph-tv.com.
Phone: normal Movies/Series browsing leaves Favourites and loads the first category, with no duplicate type/filter strips; account switching stays in Settings.
Phone: Home-only top library tools, centered dark wordmark, unclipped update notice, themed category drawer, compact Apply action and restored remote artwork.
Shared IPTV and local-file player, clear -10/+10 controls and responsive transport layout.
Live, Movies and Series open on Favourites; a unified category list keeps provider categories visible in Recently added and Continue watching, with thin separators and deliberate Right navigation.
Automatic Adhan while Launcher or IPTV is foreground: pauses playing video and resumes after Adhan; does not run over HDMI or another app.
Local media opens a file directly; previous/next traverse the selected folder.
Compact Launcher settings, focus-only highlights, combined prayer/match summary and lower slider pager.
Direct Parent Control settings entry; Speed Test with measured download/upload/HTTP latency and animated progress.

User-owned WireGuard profiles: embedded Android engine; Windows/macOS use installed OS tunnel tools and require system consent. Samsung/LG cannot run a device-wide tunnel through this web app; device/router VPN remains separate.
Windows installer uses the approved Morph Launcher wordmark banner; support opens the website payment options.
Samsung/LG input handoff releases the old player before opening a TV source. Physical HDMI validation remains outstanding.
LG packages target Chromium53 for webOS4.x compatibility; LK5730PVC physical support remains unverified.
validation: Android native account persistence / real D-pad / IME / player instrumentation
Samsung and LG transport/player regression fixtures
Launcher 1GB / 2-core / CPU x4 simulation; no active blur or reflections
sharedSourceReceipt: current canonical source verified across the embedded and standalone TV matrix
startupFix: Android local DOM readiness reveals Home without waiting for external page-finished; regression tested on Google TV Android 14, old build fails the same negative control.
faithUpdates: Unified centered Morph TV wordmark and Back on every worship page
Lighter prayer artwork overlay; bounded Arabic Qibla verse and blue needle
Original Her tap audio asset and native vibration/sound channel restored
mediaApp: Visible Media Player app, pinned once for existing and new launcher profiles; opens direct local-file selection on Android and desktop.
